user.title: Add an aquarium
user.description: After creating it, use Add light, Add device and Add sensor on the integration page to add its equipment.

user.title: Light
user.description: Choose how this light is controlled.

data_description.control: On/off: a smart plug or switch. Dimmable: a smart light with brightness. Modes by power cycling: a lamp like the Aquael LEDDY DAY & NIGHT that changes mode when it is switched off and on again quickly.

details.title: Light settings
details.description: Schedule: one change per line, for example 12:00 Day, 19:00 Daybreak, 20:00 off. Use on, off, a brightness such as 60% for dimmable lights, or a mode name.

data.reset_time: Off time that resets the mode

data_description.modes: In the order the lamp goes through them. The first one is the mode the lamp starts in after being off for a while.
data_description.toggle_delay: How long to wait after each off and each on while switching modes.
data_description.reset_time: If the lamp stays off at least this long, it starts again from the first mode.
data_description.transition: Fade time for scheduled changes, if the light supports it.

error.invalid_modes: Enter at least two different modes.
error.reset_too_short: Must be longer than the delay between toggles.

user.title: Device
user.description: Equipment switched by a smart plug or switch, such as CO2, a filter or a heater. Schedule: one change per line, for example 11:00 on and 19:00 off. Leave it empty to switch the device only by hand.

user.title: Sensor
user.description: Show a reading, such as water temperature or pH, with this aquarium. Set a minimum or maximum to get an Out of range alert.

error.max_not_above_min: The maximum must be higher than the minimum.
